chunks: ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Ibn Miskān, from al-Muthannā, from Abī Baṣīr, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, concerning:
Regarding the junub when he dies, he said: “There is only one washing upon him.”

key_terms.الْجُنُبِ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ: there is not upon him; no further obligation applies

ai.seo_question: Does a deceased person in the state of janabah require more than one ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a deceased person who was in the state of janabah at the time of death. It states that only a single ghusl is required for such a person, indicating that the death-related washing suffices.
